title: High-Order Structure-Preserving SBP Finite Difference Methods for the Vlasov-Maxwell System on Matrix-Free GPUs
summary: In this paper, we present a high-order, stable summation-by-parts (SBP) finite difference method for solving the Vlasov-Maxwell system in a 2D2V phase space. Central SBP operators for the advection terms are not stable when the solution becomes non-smooth and fine-scale filamentary structures develop, as is typical in high-dimensional Vlasov-Maxwell simulations. To address this issue, the method is stabilized using high-order upwind SBP operators. High-order explicit Runge-Kutta methods are employed for time integration.
